parts.text: Turn the creature so his head and body face about 45 degrees to the viewer's right, three-quarter view like a standard collectible figure portrait, at the same large size in frame: head near the top, upper body filling the frame, both bat wings visible behind his shoulders. Keep the same tentacle-faced design, clay finish, stormy sea, moon, hooded cultists and the plain glowing green ring with no symbol. No text.
